breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the polar moment of inertia J = π d^4/32 throughout the torsional strain energy calculation. There is no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 in place of J. The specification aligns with the ground truth by consistently applying J in the torsion formula U = ∫[0→L] T^2/(2GJ) dx.
